concepts.gloss_en: The imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh), identified in Torah 54 with a depressed/evil spirit

members.note: same Torah (lm1:54), same referent — the imaginative faculty as ruach ra'ah/atzvut ruach; note the proof text itself reads המדמה, so the article difference is superficial and non-distinguishing here

notes: Both forms are the imaginative faculty, not a person-archetype, so the definite-article archetype rule does not apply. The listed bare form מדמה is quoted in context as המדמה, confirming identity.
